Add a new journal entry

## Usage

    gournal add <summary> [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Comma-separated tags | (empty) |
| `-d, --details <text>` | Longer text for this entry |  |
| `-k, --kind <kind>` | done (default), blocker, or next |  |
| `--resolves <ids>` | Comma-separated ids of open blocker or next entries that this entry closes |  |
